**3B.3 Research Note**

**Assessment:** I found **no credible 2024 evidence** that Jokowi personally incited hatred, revenge, dehumanization, scapegoating, or violence against opponents, minorities, journalists, civil society, or ethnic/religious groups. The 2024 record I could verify is instead dominated by restraint-oriented public statements, especially on Palestine / Middle East escalation.

**Accepted Claims**
- **President Jokowi Tegaskan Dialog Adalah Solusi Terbaik untuk Konflik di Timur Tengah** | **Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia** | **2024-10-05** | [URL](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-tegaskan-dialog-adalah-solusi-terbaik-untuk-konflik-di-timur-timur/) | Jokowi said dialogue is the best way to reduce escalation and urged all parties to restrain themselves. This is direct anti-incitement evidence, not hate or revenge rhetoric. | **3B.3**, **2B.7**
- **Indonesia Condemns Israeli Attacks on Gaza, Lebanon, UN Peacekeepers** | **Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia** | **2024-10-15** | [URL](https://setkab.go.id/en/indonesia-condemns-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-lebanon-un-peacekeepers/) | Jokowi condemned attacks on civilians and UN peacekeepers and called for restraint and an end to armed conflict. This supports a finding that he did not personally encourage violence or dehumanization in public crisis rhetoric. | **3B.3**, **2B.7**, **3B.1**
- **President Jokowi Strongly Opposes PM Netanyahu’s Statement on Palestinian Statehood** | **Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia** | **2024-01-26** | [URL](https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-strongly-opposes-pm-netanyahus-statement-on-palestinian-statehood/) | Jokowi rejected Netanyahu’s anti-two-state statement, condemned attacks, and directed Indonesia’s foreign minister to keep voicing support for the Palestinian cause. The statement is framed as diplomacy and restraint rather than hate or scapegoating. | **3B.3**, **2B.7**
- **Pernyataan Presiden RI Terkait Dukungan untuk Palestina di Istana Kepresidenan Bogor** | **Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia** | **2024-01-26** | [URL](https://setkab.go.id/pernyataan-presiden-ri-terkait-dukungan-untuk-palestina-di-istana-kepresidenan-bogor-provinsi-jawa-barat-26-januari-2024/) | Jokowi said Indonesia would continue supporting Palestine, condemned attacks on Khan Younis, and said Indonesian ports would not be used for Israeli interests. He grounded the position in international law and humanitarian restraint, not fear-mongering or dehumanization. | **3B.3**, **2B.7**
- **Indonesia and China Want Regional Peace and Stability** | **Reuters via Investing.com** | **2024-04-17/18** | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-foreign-minister-says-beijing-and-jakarta-want-regional-peace-and-stability-3383690) | During Jakarta talks, Indonesia and China emphasized regional peace and stability and backed a UN ceasefire resolution on Gaza. This is indirect but still consistent with a non-incendiary public posture. | **3B.3**, **2B.7**

**Search Gap**
- I found **no reliable 2024 source** showing Jokowi personally used hate speech, dehumanizing language, revenge framing, or direct calls for violence against any protected or political group.
- The closest negative material in the provided record concerns **election favoritism/patronage** and **Papua security abuses by subordinates**; those are relevant to other lenses, but they do **not** establish personal incitement under 3B.3.
- So the evidence base for 3B.3 is **asymmetric**: clear restraint-oriented statements on one side, and **no solid direct incitement evidence** on the other.
